title: Devi Mahatmyam (Durga Saptashati)

attribution.traditionalLocation: Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa (the Sāvarṇika manvantara section; GRETIL adhyāyas 81–93)

sources.label: Śrīdurgāsaptaśatī, Gita Press, Gorakhpur — digital text in github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts (purANam/durgA-saptashatI/goraxapura-pAThaH)
sources.note: The base text: 700 mantras with the Gita Press numbering and chapter colophons.

sources.label: GRETIL Mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇa, adhyāyas 81–93 (Sansknet input, not proof-read), via github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts
sources.note: Independent witness; aligned letter by letter against every chapter.

sources.label: Peter Freund, Śrī Durgā Saptaśatī (transcription), via github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts
sources.note: Second independent witness of the recited Saptaśatī.

translation.note: The padaccheda, word tables, sandhi and samāsa analysis, translations and commentary were prepared for PaddySpeaks in the 2026-10 study edition (devi-mahatmyam/edition/). They are not taken from a published translation; commentary is labelled by its authority and doubtful points are flagged.

verification.method: Automated proof: 13 chapters, 700 mantras, numbering without gaps, each chapter's uvāca / half-śloka / śloka counts equal to its own colophon; every padaccheda rejoins by the rules of sandhi into the recited text; every word table matches its padaccheda; every logged correction is present in the text.
verification.scope: internal consistency of edition/text.json and the analysis

verification.method: Letter-by-letter alignment of the whole text with two independent witnesses (GRETIL Mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇa 81–93, Peter Freund's Saptaśatī); every place where the Gita Press text differed from both was examined and logged as a correction or a variant.

knownIssues.summary: Variant readings marked 'Textual Verification Required' (devi-mahatmyam/edition/corrections.json) should be checked against the printed Gita Press book, which was not available when the edition was made.

statusNote: Text extracted from the Gita Press digital edition, cross-checked against two witnesses and machine-proven; not yet checked against the printed book.
